desc: Write the single-file Python solution implementing the prefix-relative-seen-set algorithm with integer coordinate encoding (M=4N+10, offset=2N+5), reading from stdin and writing the N-char answer to stdout.
Test on all three provided samples, verifying outputs 001010, 0001101011, 00100111111000101111 (all passed).
Test edge cases: t=1 immediate hit, all-same-direction wind, duplicate prefix values, and large N=200000 for performance.
Confirm reduction: smoke at time t+0.5 is at (R,C) iff P[t]-(R,C) has appeared among P[0..t-1] (i.e., in seen before inserting P[t]).
Establish birth times = first occurrences of prefix values, so checking the seen set (including P[0]=(0,0)) at each step is sufficient.
